# DOMA Fabricators
> DOMA Fabricators is a professionally managed industrial fabrication company located in Pithampur, Madhya Pradesh, India. Founded over 25 years ago, it specializes in piping works, heavy structural fabrication, equipment erection, industrial maintenance, tank fabrication, shed works, and roofing. The company serves Oil & Gas, Chemical, Petroleum Refinery, and Paint industries with 500+ completed projects, 120+ engineers, and ISO 45001 certification. Contact: +91 90987 89399 | domafabricators@gmail.com | WhatsApp: +91 90987 89399

## Core Services
- **Piping Works:** Plant piping services for industrial applications
- **Site-Tank Fabrication:** Tank Farms, SS/MS Tanks, FRP Lining
- **Equipment Erection:** Precision placement and installation
- **Industrial Maintenance:** Comprehensive facility maintenance
- **Shed Works & Roofing:** Industrial construction services
- **Design & Engineering:** End-to-end project support
